examples.name: basics-wordcount_1.py
examples.title: 词频统计·Top3
examples.description: Counter 统计文本词频并输出 TopN。本变体：Top3。
examples.code:
"""词频统计：Top {topn}。"""
from collections import Counter

text = """python is simple python is powerful and python is everywhere simple tools with powerful ideas make python everywhere python"""
words = [w.strip(".,!?;:()").lower() for w in text.split()]
words = [w for w in words if w]
counter = Counter(words)
for word, cnt in counter.most_common({topn}):
    print(f"{word:>12}  {cnt}")
print("去重词数:", len(counter))

examples.name: algo-quick-sort_1.py
examples.title: 快速排序·n=20
examples.description: 手写快排（尾递归式分区）。本变体：n=20。
examples.code:
"""快速排序：20 个随机整数。"""
import random
random.seed(1)
data = [random.randint(0, 100) for _ in range(20)]

def qsort(arr):
    if len(arr) <= 1:
        return arr
    pivot = arr[len(arr) // 2]
    left = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
    mid = [x for x in arr if x == pivot]
    right = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
    return qsort(left) + mid + qsort(right)

print("原:", data[:12], "...")
print("排序后:", qsort(data)[:12], "...")

examples.name: algo-knapsack_1.py
examples.title: 0-1 背包·容量10
examples.description: 动态规划背包最优值与回溯。本变体：容量10。
examples.code:
"""0-1 背包：容量 10，{{n}} 件物品。"""
weights = [2, 3, 5, 7]
values = [3, 4, 5, 9]
cap = 10
dp = [0] * (cap + 1)
for w, v in zip(weights, values):
    for c in range(cap, w - 1, -1):
        dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - w] + v)
print("最大价值:", dp[cap])

examples.name: tools-base-convert_1.py
examples.title: 进制转换器·n255
examples.description: 任意 2~36 进制互转。本变体：n255。
examples.code:
"""进制转换：十进制 255 的各进制表示。"""
num = 255
for base in ['2, 8, 16, 32']:
    digits = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    out = ""
    n = num
    while n:
        out = digits[n % base] + out
        n //= base
    print(f"base-{{base:>2}}: {{out or '0'}}")

examples.description: 任意 2~36 进制互转。本变体：n1024。
examples.code:
"""进制转换：十进制 1024 的各进制表示。"""
num = 1024
for base in ['2, 8, 16, 32']:
    digits = "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    out = ""
    n = num
    while n:
        out = digits[n % base] + out
        n //= base
    print(f"base-{{base:>2}}: {{out or '0'}}")

examples.name: tools-text-table_1.py
examples.title: 文本表格·商品
examples.description: 格式化对齐输出 Markdown 表格。本变体：商品。
examples.code:
"""文本表格：4 行对齐输出。"""
headers = ["名称", "数量", "单价"]
data = ["[['苹果', 12, 5.5], ['香蕉', 30, 3.2], ['橙子', 8, 6.0], ['葡萄', 15, 9.9]]"]
widths = [max(len(str(headers[i])), max(len(str(r[i])) for r in data)) for i in range(3)]
line = "| " + " | ".join(h.ljust(w) for h, w in zip(headers, widths)) + " |"
print(line)
print("|" + "|".join("-" * (w + 2) for w in widths) + "|")
for r in data:
    print("| " + " | ".join(str(c).ljust(w) for c, w in zip(r, widths)) + " |")

examples.name: algo-collatz_x1.py
examples.title: 考拉兹猜想·L1000
examples.description: 3n+1 序列步数统计。本变体：L1000。
examples.code:
"""考拉兹序列：起点 27，最长链搜索到 1000。"""
def collatz_len(n):
    steps = 0
    while n != 1:
        n = n // 2 if n % 2 == 0 else 3 * n + 1
        steps += 1
    return steps

print("起点 27 步数:", collatz_len(27))
best = max(range(1, 1000), key=lambda n: (collatz_len(n), -n))
print(f"1~1000 中链最长: {{best}} ({{collatz_len(best)}} 步)")

examples.name: algo-matrix-rotate_x1.py
examples.title: 矩阵旋转·n4m9
examples.description: n×n 矩阵原地旋转 90 度。本变体：n4m9。
examples.code:
"""矩阵旋转：4×4 顺时针 90°。"""
n = 4
mat = [[(i * n + j) % 9 for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
print("旋转前:", mat[0])
for layer in range(n // 2):
    first, last = layer, n - 1 - layer
    for i in range(first, last):
        off = i - first
        top = mat[first][i]
        mat[first][i] = mat[last - off][first]
        mat[last - off][first] = mat[last][last - off]
        mat[last][last - off] = mat[i][last]
        mat[i][last] = top
print("旋转后:", mat[0])
